Row.Text: Adds a Canal building to each age. Build it on a land tile that separates two bodies of water; when it is finished the tile becomes a coast tile with a quay on it, and ships sail through. Unlocked by Engineering, Shipbuilding and Industrialization. Single-player games only.

Cuts a ship channel through a narrow neck of land. Can only be built on a land tile that separates two bodies of water. When it is finished the tile becomes a coast tile with a quay, and ships can sail through it.
Turns a land tile between two bodies of water into a navigable channel when completed.
A Canal must be built on a land tile that separates two bodies of water.
A Canal cannot be dug through a tile that holds a resource.
A Canal cannot be dug through a National Park.
Nothing else can be built on a canal.
Canals cannot be dug in a multiplayer game.

Canals is for single-player games.[N][N]Digging a canal turns a tile of land into water, and in a multiplayer game that change would not reach the other players' games, so no Canal can be built in this one.

This save was made with an earlier version of Canals, which saved canals as open water, so this time they are drawn as open sea. They still work as canals.[N][N]To draw them as canals again, the game saves and loads once: Reload now writes this turn's autosave and loads it.[N][N]Otherwise they look right after your next save and load.

Canals was added to this game after {2_Tech} was researched, so the game keeps the {1_Canal} locked for the rest of this age.[N][N]It is sold for gold in each settlement's purchase list instead of being built with production.
